items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: I had been listening to these Charlie Parker records that I had bought from this shop.

ctx.x: Yeah but all 78's. Not in the late 40s.

All 78's, I don't remember seeing it. If there was, I believe, Jazz to Philharmonic was the first LP I saw. And that's where I first heard Charlie Park on him. He played Lady Be Good and I said yeah that's the saxophone play I wanted. Well I really first heard him when I was graduating from high school, because Wallace, Wallace Allen was in my class, he and I graduated together. Was he in the band? No. Wallace was, well he was a man when I was a kid because he had been in the Navy band. Oh yeah. And the band was…
